name: opus-tools
description: Gives Claude eyes for game assets: inspect and clean pixel art, lock palettes, render 3D models from every side, and lint meshes for game-readiness (Blender + Godot)

blender_path.title: Blender executable
blender_path.description: Full path to blender.exe (Blender 5.1+). Leave empty to auto-detect from the standard install folders.

godot_path.title: Godot executable
godot_path.description: Full path to the Godot 4.7 executable. Leave empty to auto-detect.

library_dir.title: Asset library folder
library_dir.description: Folder for downloaded asset, sound and motion libraries (see DOWNLOADS.md). Can be left empty for now.
